summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. and A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the English translation of a payment notice for its Series XLV Fixed Rate Notes (USD 10,199,068 outstanding, 6.00% annual interest). The filing announces that on August 24, 2026, the fifth installment of interest and full capital amortization will be paid, covering the period April 22, 2026 through August 22, 2026. Interest amount is USD 204,540.21, with principal repayment of USD 10,199,068. Payment agent is Caja de Valores S.A. This is a routine debt service notification, not a special situation.
